title: CAER: Causal Action Effect Reweighting for World Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.30897v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models are becoming core infrastructure for embodied intelligence, with action-conditioned video generation providing controllable predictions of how scenes evolve after agent interventions. Yet existing models are commonly trained with space-time-uniform mean squared error, allowing abundant background tokens to dominate the gradient while sparse interaction dynamics remain under-optimized; such uniform fitting rewards reconstructing appearance rather than learning how actions change the world. We introduce Causal Action Effect Reweighting (CAER), a general training paradigm that redistributes supervision toward the tokens whose predicted future is causally affected by the action. CAER contrasts the model's own predictions with and without action conditioning to localize these tokens online, then normalizes the resulting effect map into a weight that preserves the total coefficient mass and changes only where it is spent. translated_title: CAER：面向世界模型训练的因果动作效应重加权
translated_abstract: 世界模型正在成为具身智能的核心基础设施，其中动作条件视频生成能够对智能体干预后场景如何演变提供可控预测。然而，现有模型通常采用时空均匀的均方误差进行训练，导致大量背景token主导梯度，而稀疏的交互动态却得不到充分优化；这种均匀拟合奖励的是外观重建，而非学习动作如何改变世界。我们提出了因果动作效应重加权（CAER），这是一种通用的训练范式，将监督重新分配到那些预测未来受动作因果影响的token上。CAER通过对比模型自身在有动作条件与无动作条件下的预测来在线定位这些token，然后将所得的效应图归一化为权重，该权重在保持总系数质量不变的前提下，仅改变其分布位置。这种在线...
tldr: CAER提出了一种通用的世界模型训练范式，通过对比模型在有、无动作条件下的预测来在线定位受动作因果影响的token，并将监督权重重新分配至这些token，使模型学习动作如何改变世界而非仅仅重建外观。
en_tdlr: CAER is a general training paradigm for world models that online localizes action-causally-affected tokens by contrasting the model's predictions with and without action conditioning, then redistributes supervision weights toward these tokens, teaching the model how actions change the world rather than merely reconstructing appearance.
